name: Yamaha Motor Co., Ltd.
summary: Yamaha Motor Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in land mobility, marine, outdoor land vehicles, robotics, financial services, and other businesses in Japan, the United States, the rest of North America, Europe, Indonesia, the rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers WaveRunners, snowmobiles, and e-bike systems; and power products, SMT assembly systems, performance dampers, unmanned systems, pools, clean water supply systems, OEM casting and forging, cell picking and imaging systems, and electric motors.
